summary: X389 is a highly disciplined execution of the scene spec. It successfully dramatizes the 'three-second beat' and 'one clean question' as epistemic tools that reclaim agency from an acquisitive interpreter. The romantic climax is the scene's strongest point, treating chastity not as a lack of desire, but as a precise direction of it. The prose occasionally leans on repetitive 'felt like' and 'simply' constructions (as noted in preflight), and there are moments of interiority regarding Jonah that border on mindreading, but the causal engine of the scene—the movement from the suffocating 'kindness' of the group to the sovereign choice of the couple—is powerful and precise.
